pre_support_4: Please rate on a scale from 0 to 100. - To what extent do you try to understand the experiences of people from other backgrounds? (0 = Not at all, 100 = To a very great extent)

pre_policy_3: Please rate on a scale from 0 to 100. - Refugees should be supported in finding employment through government-funded job programs. (0 = Completely disagree, 100 = Completely agree)
pre_policy_4: Please rate on a scale from 0 to 100. - The government should ensure equal access to healthcare and social services for refugees. (0 = Completely disagree, 100 = Completely agree)
